title.en: Identifying nodes: MAC and IP addresses
title.kn: ನೋಡ್‌ಗಳ ಗುರುತಿಸುವಿಕೆ: MAC ಮತ್ತು IP ವಿಳಾಸಗಳು

hook.en: A letter needs a house address to arrive. A packet needs an address too. In fact, every device has two: one fixed in its hardware, and one given by the network it joins.
hook.kn: ಪತ್ರ ತಲುಪಲು ಮನೆಯ ವಿಳಾಸ ಬೇಕು. ಪ್ಯಾಕೆಟ್‌ಗೂ ವಿಳಾಸ ಬೇಕು. ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಾಧನಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ವಿಳಾಸಗಳಿವೆ: ಯಂತ್ರಾಂಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾದದ್ದು, ಮತ್ತು ಸೇರುವ ಜಾಲ ನೀಡುವುದು.

objectives.en: Describe the format of a MAC address

narration.en: A letter needs a house address to arrive. A packet needs an address too. In fact, every device has two: one fixed in its hardware, and one given by the network it joins.
narration.kn: ಪತ್ರ ತಲುಪಲು ಮನೆಯ ವಿಳಾಸ ಬೇಕು. ಪ್ಯಾಕೆಟ್‌ಗೂ ವಿಳಾಸ ಬೇಕು. ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಾಧನಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ವಿಳಾಸಗಳಿವೆ: ಯಂತ್ರಾಂಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾದದ್ದು, ಮತ್ತು ಸೇರುವ ಜಾಲ ನೀಡುವುದು.

body.en: The MAC (Media Access Control) address is a unique 48-bit (6-byte) physical address assigned to each NIC by its manufacturer. It is written as six pairs of hexadecimal digits separated by colons or hyphens, e.g. FC:F8:AE:CE:7B:16. The first three bytes are the manufacturer's Organisational Unique Identifier (OUI); the last three are the card's serial number. A MAC address normally does not change.

narration.en: A MAC address is a 48-bit hardware address written as six pairs of hex digits. The first half identifies the manufacturer, and it normally never changes.
narration.kn: MAC ವಿಳಾಸ 48-ಬಿಟ್ ಯಂತ್ರಾಂಶ ವಿಳಾಸ; ಆರು ಜೋಡಿ ಹೆಕ್ಸ್ ಅಂಕಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಮೊದಲ ಅರ್ಧ ತಯಾರಕರನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

body.en: An IP (Internet Protocol) address is a logical address that identifies a node on a network and is used to route packets. IPv4 uses 32 bits, written as four decimal numbers from 0 to 255 separated by dots, e.g. 192.168.0.178. Because $2^{32}$ (about 4.3 billion) addresses are not enough, IPv6 uses 128 bits, written as eight groups of hexadecimal digits. An IP address can change when a device moves to another network.

narration.en: An IP address is a logical address used for routing. IPv4 has 32 bits as four numbers from 0 to 255; IPv6 has 128 bits.
narration.kn: IP ವಿಳಾಸ ಮಾರ್ಗನಿರ್ದೇಶನಕ್ಕೆ ಬಳಸುವ ತಾರ್ಕಿಕ ವಿಳಾಸ. IPv4 32 ಬಿಟ್, 0–255 ರ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು; IPv6 128 ಬಿಟ್.

narration.en: Type an IPv4 address and see its four 8-bit parts in binary. Enter 192.168.1.25 and check that each part fits in 8 bits. Try a part larger than 255 and see why it is invalid.

problem.en: Check which are valid IPv4 addresses: (i) 10.0.0.1, (ii) 256.10.20.30, (iii) 172.16.5, (iv) 192.168.1.254.

steps.en: Rule: exactly four parts, each from 0 to 255.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Check which are valid IPv4 addresses: (i) 10.0.0.1, (ii) 256.10.20.30, (iii) 172.16.5, (iv) 192.168.1.254.

problem.en: How many bits are in the MAC address 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E, and which part identifies the manufacturer?

steps.en: There are 6 pairs of hex digits = 6 bytes.
The first three bytes 00:1A:2B are the OUI of the manufacturer.

points.en: MAC address: 48-bit physical address of the NIC.
points.kn: MAC ವಿಳಾಸ: NIC ನ 48-ಬಿಟ್ ಭೌತಿಕ ವಿಳಾಸ.

points.en: First 3 bytes of MAC identify the manufacturer.
points.kn: MAC ನ ಮೊದಲ 3 ಬೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ತಯಾರಕರನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: IP is logical and may change; MAC normally does not.
points.kn: IP ತಾರ್ಕಿಕ, ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದು; MAC ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಬದಲಾಗದು.

homework.en: Find the MAC and IP address of your phone in its settings and identify each part.

narration.en: Recap. MAC address: 48-bit physical address of the NIC. First 3 bytes of MAC identify the manufacturer. IPv4 is 32-bit (four numbers 0–255); IPv6 is 128-bit. IP is logical and may change; MAC normally does not.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. MAC ವಿಳಾಸ: NIC ನ 48-ಬಿಟ್ ಭೌತಿಕ ವಿಳಾಸ. MAC ನ ಮೊದಲ 3 ಬೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ತಯಾರಕರನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. IPv4 32-ಬಿಟ್ (0–255 ರ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ); IPv6 128-ಬಿಟ್. IP ತಾರ್ಕಿಕ, ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದು; MAC ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಬದಲಾಗದು.
